findings.evidence: The docstrings discuss the induction used by `biUnion_finset`, what callers otherwise do by hand, and claim this theorem is “the only route from smoothness into the predicate”.
findings.fix: State finite-indexed-union closure and the smooth-cube introduction rule directly; remove “the form above is the induction”, caller-workaround commentary, and “the only route” claim.

summary: Several new public docstrings narrate proof implementation or repository API status instead of documenting the declarations’ results.
